title: Pizza: From Street Food to World Favourite
intro: You are going to read about the history of one of the world’s favourite foods.

passage: Today you can eat pizza almost everywhere, from New York to Tashkent. But three hundred years ago, very few people outside one Italian city knew about it. That city was Naples, in the south of Italy.

In the 1700s, Naples was a big city, and many of its people were poor. They worked long hours and did not have much time to cook. They needed food that was cheap and quick. Street sellers made flat bread with simple toppings, such as garlic, oil, cheese or small fish. People bought a piece and ate it with their hands while they walked. Rich people thought this dish was food for the poor, and they did not eat it.

There is a famous story about the most popular pizza of all. In 1889, Queen Margherita of Italy visited Naples. A cook called Raffaele Esposito made three pizzas for her, and she liked one best. It had three simple ingredients: red tomatoes, white mozzarella cheese and green basil leaves. These are the colours of the Italian flag. The cook named the pizza ‘Margherita’ in her honour. Some historians say this story is not completely true, but the name is still used today.

At the end of the 1800s, millions of Italians left their country and moved to America. These immigrants took their recipes with them. In 1905, Gennaro Lombardi opened a pizzeria in New York. People often call it the first pizzeria in the USA. At first, most of his customers were Italian, but soon other Americans started to enjoy pizza too.

After 1945, pizza spread quickly around the world. Shops began to deliver hot pizzas to people’s homes by car or on motorbikes. Cooks in different countries invented new kinds with chicken, corn or even pineapple. Many people in Naples still think that pineapple on pizza is a terrible idea! But one thing is clear: the cheap street food of Naples is now one of the world’s favourite meals.

mcq.q: Why did poor people in Naples buy pizza?
options: It was good for their health.

mcq.q: Why is the Margherita pizza red, white and green?
options: They were the queen’s favourite colours.
They are the colours of the Italian flag.
The cook had no other ingredients.

mcq.q: How did pizza first come to the USA?
options: Queen Margherita sent a cook there.
